basic_details.job_title: MPSC Talathi Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 1539 Village Revenue Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) Talathi Recruitment 2026 notification has been released under Advertisement No. 017/2026 on the official website. A total of 1,539 vacancies have been announced for Talathi (Village Revenue Officer), Group-C posts through the MPSC Group-C Services Combined Preliminary Examination 2026.

application_fee.details: Fee can be paid online through the MPSC application portal via credit card, debit card, or net banking, or offline via SBI challan. The fee is non-refundable.

age_limit.details: Minimum age: 18–19 years Maximum age (Open/General): 38 years Maximum age (Reserved categories – OBC/SC/ST/NT etc.): 43 years (5-year relaxation) Further relaxation applies for project-affected, persons with disabilities, and ex-servicemen candidates, per standard government norms

qualification.details: Educational qualification and age must be held as on 5 August 2026, the last date for application submission.
qualification.education_qualification: Any degree from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Maharashtra Government

selection_process: Maharashtra Group-C Services Combined Preliminary Examination (computer-based/OMR as notified) Main Examination for candidates who qualify the preliminary exam
how_to_apply: Visit the official MPSC website at mpsconline.gov.in
Register or log in to your existing profile
Complete the KYC process as required
Fill in the online application form for the Talathi post
Upload the required documents in the specified format and size
Pay the application fee online or via SBI challan
important_instructions: The application fee is non-refundable Candidates should complete KYC verification well before the last date Correspondence address determines the examination centre allotted Carry a valid original photo ID to the exam centre Electronic devices, including mobile phones, are prohibited inside the exam centre

Candidates who have completed their graduate degree can also explore more Graduate Government Jobs and Maharashtra Government Jobs available across the state. Applicants looking for more revenue and administrative roles can also check MPSC Clerk-Typist Recruitment 2026 and other MPSC Combined Exam notifications for upcoming vacancies.

content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates Caste/category certificate, if applicable Non-creamy layer certificate, if applicable Domicile certificate, if applicable Disability certificate, if applicable Ex-servicemen discharge certificate, if applicable Recent passport-size photograph and signature

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPSC Talathi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official MPSC website at mpsconline.gov.in Register or log in to your existing profile Complete the KYC process as required Fill in the online application form for the Talathi post Upload the required documents in the specified format and size Pay the application fee online or via SBI challan Submit the application before 5 August 2026

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for MPSC Talathi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MPSC has announced 1,539 vacancies for the Talathi (Village Revenue Officer) post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MPSC Talathi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 5 August 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for MPSC Talathi 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold any degree from a recognised university, or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Maharashtra Government.

faq.question: Q4. When is the MPSC Talathi Preliminary Exam 2026?
faq.answer: The preliminary exam is scheduled for 25 October 2026, in offline OMR-based mode.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for MPSC Talathi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The combined preliminary exam fee is ₹394 for Open category, ₹294 for reserved categories, and ₹44 for ex-servicemen (Group-C posts).

faq.question: Q6. Which department is recruiting for the Talathi post?
faq.answer: The Talathi posts are being filled by the Revenue & Forest Department, Government of Maharashtra

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for MPSC Talathi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through mpsconline.gov.in by registering, completing KYC, filling the application form, uploading documents, and paying the fee before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MPSC Talathi exam part of a combined exam with other posts?
faq.answer: Yes, Talathi recruitment is being conducted through the Maharashtra Group-C Services Combined Preliminary Examination 2026, which also covers posts such as Clerk-Typist, Assistant Fisheries Development Officer, Senior Record Keeper, and Assistant Superintendent.
